weights_interpretation.ct: n_trials is unique NCT ids per disease_concept_id and drug_key
weights_interpretation.pubtator_disease_frequency: pmid_count_sum and total_articles_sum reflect literature volume per disease
weights_interpretation.pubtator_drug_summary: pmid_count_sum_max and total_articles_sum_max summarize literature volume per normalized drug name

entity_resolution_policy.disease: exact normalized label match else token multiset match with simple singularization, ambiguous and blocked removed from overlap tables, unmatched diseases kept as CT_unique concepts
entity_resolution_policy.drug: linking based on normalized drug_key = norm_basic(drug_name) in both sources, without synonym expansion at this stage

notes.dropped_analyses: Per_drug Jaccard and edge level network comparisons are omitted because the current PubTator export does not include per_drug_per_disease edge rows in these summary files.
